notes: Firm-month panel, Nov 2017 - Apr 2019 (18 months), firms whose initial CEO pay ratio disclosure (first DEF 14A with the ratio) falls in Feb 2018 - Jan 2019; SAS Code.sas lines 861-894. treat = (yearmonth >= event_yearmonth): absorbing, no switch-offs. 12 monthly adoption cohorts (event_yearmonth 24218-24229); active-sample firm-months per cohort from the stacking tabs in Stata Log.log: Feb18 177, Mar18 7686, Apr18 9457, May18 841, Jun18 676, Jul18 446, Aug18 412, Sep18 588, Oct18 531, Nov18 272, Dec18 754, Jan19 725 (sum 22,565 = active sample incl. missing-outcome months). No never-treated firms (events outside the window are deleted); no always-treated firms (earliest cohort Feb 2018 vs panel start Nov 2017). Jan-Apr 2019 has no untreated firm-month. Rows before the previous proxy filing and from the next proxy filing onward are dropped (SAS lines 900-901), and rows with any missing control are dropped at dataset construction, so the no-controls column uses the same N as the controls column. active_sample = firm has a non-missing rating in at least one of months -3..-1 and one of +1..+3 (1,360 firms of 2,024). Preferred flag follows the screening record; column 3 (with controls, 0.049) may be the authors' headline column, re-check against the article. Abstract reports the increase in pay satisfaction qualitatively, without a number.
